headline: Orders link only to the right customer, serial numbers follow parked shipments, and Add Lines handles more orders at once.
whatsNew: Add Lines from Source Record takes about 25 orders in one flow run, up from about 10.
A user whose salesperson link Salesforce refuses now shows in Records Not Synced with Retry, and the Salespeople sync still succeeds.
The Home upgrade banner names the full version that is available.

headline: Credit notes sync while the Invoices sync is off, and Records Not Synced says where to fix each record.
whatsNew: Credit notes sync while the Invoices sync is off, keeping the invoice number, so they no longer wait for an invoice that never comes.
Records Not Synced says whether to fix a record in Unleashed or in Salesforce, and shows a refused value in quotation marks.

headline: The first release: your Unleashed customers, products, stock and sales in Salesforce, with sales orders created from Salesforce.
whatsNew: Connect Unleashed and sync customers and contacts, products with tier price books, stock on hand, quotes, orders, invoices, shipments and credit notes.
Edits to linked Accounts and Contacts go back to Unleashed, so the customer record stays the same in both.
Create Unleashed sales orders from an Opportunity, or from another record such as a Work Order, with the New Order card.
Follow every serialised unit from shipment to return, and see each customer's Unleashed orders and quotes on the Account and Opportunity cards.
Give people one of three access levels, and see any record that could not sync, with the reason and the fix, in Records Not Synced.
afterUpgrade: Open Unleashed Home and follow its steps, from connecting Unleashed to Import Data. The Admin Guide walks through each step.
